question: What constitutes the inner form of bathing?
premises: The inner bath is a flooding by the nectar-stream of the upper moon.
This occurs above the cranial aperture.
It pervades a span of one and a half finger-widths and remains established there.
inference: Inner bathing is an internal inundation by lunar nectar localized above the cranial aperture.
uncertainties: The exact anatomical referent of randhra is assumed to be the cranial aperture.
plain_english: The inner bath is the flooding of nectar from the upper moon, established above the cranial aperture and pervading a span of one and a half finger-widths.
